changelog: DeskRT 60 FPS Delta Engine: Zero-copy uint32 vectorized diff and dirty bounding box clustering eliminating frame drop bottlenecks
Ultra-Low Latency VoIP Engine: Continuous playback sample ring buffer fixing sample slicing, stuttering, and robotic audio distortions
Smart WASAPI Audio Selection: Automatic physical headset/microphone detection prioritizing low-latency WASAPI devices over virtual cables
In-App Voice & Audio Controls: Dedicated in-app Audio Settings panel with live VU meter test, mic gain slider, and session toolbar volume control
AnyDesk-style Incoming Session Request Dialog with audio chime alert and Topmost visibility
Granular Session Permissions: Allow/Deny Remote Mouse & Keyboard control, Voice Audio, Clipboard Sync, and File Transfer
Dynamic Display Modes: Fit Screen, Stretch to Fill (No Black Bars), and 1:1 Original Native Resolution
Multi-Level Viewport Zoom Controls (50% to 300%) with Ctrl+MouseWheel centered zoom and middle/shift-drag panning
Digitally Signed Binaries with Authenticode SHA-256 and DigiCert RFC 3161 Timestamps
